qa.question: Do Tamers of any color make the effect of this card active?
qa.answer: Yes. No color is specified, so you can activate the effect of any Tamer, regardless of color.

qa.question: Which activates first: This card’s inherited effect, or the effect that activates when you trash this card with <Digi-Burst>?
qa.answer: The <Digi-Burst> effect activates first.

qa.question: When one of my effects digivolves a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards, does this card’s inherited effect activate?
qa.answer: No. When a Digimon digivolves, even if it happens due to an effect, it is not counted as an effect placing digivolution cards under that Digimon.

qa.question: If one of my effects places 2 or more cards at the same time under a Digimon that has this card's inherited effect, can I draw that many cards?
qa.answer: No. Even if multiple cards are added to the Digimon’s digivolution cards, if they were added by a single effect, you only draw 1 card.

qa.question: If there are Tamer cards among the cards revealed with this card's inherited effect, do I have to trash 1 of them?
qa.answer: Yes. You can choose whether or not to reveal cards from your deck, but if any Tamer cards are revealed among the cards, you must trash 1 of them.

qa.question: Does a "may digivolve this card as if the Tamer is a Digimon" effect also treat the Tamer that will become a digivolution card as a Digimon when it digivolves?
qa.answer:
Yes, it also treats the Tamer as a Digimon when it digivolves. It treats it as a Digimon that digivolves, therefore "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects will trigger.
In addition, if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect activates, digivolution won't be possible using this effect that also treats the Tamer as a Digimon.

qa.question: Is a digivolution bonus draw performed even when a Tamer digivolves?
qa.answer:
Yes, you perform a digivolution bonus draw.
A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.

qa.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack in the same turn?
qa.answer:
No, it can't.
Even if a card digivolves from a card that was placed on the field in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn. It can only attack in the turns after it's played.

qa.question: Does a Tamer card placed under a Digimon become a digivolution card?
qa.answer:
Yes, it becomes a digivolution card.
If that Digimon would leave the field, the Tamer card will be trashed like a normal digivolution card.

qa.question: Does a Digimon gain the Security effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't.

qa.question: Does a Digimon gain the Inherited effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: Can I choose to not digivolve with this card's 1st effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
For this card's 1st effect, you declare a digivolution, then upon revealing this card, you can also choose a Tamer as the card to digivolve, and that Tamer is also treated as a level 3 Digimon. As with the normal digivolution procedure, after revealing this card and declaring a digivolution, you can't choose to not digivolve.
In addition, you can't declare digivolution into this card in the first place unless there is a card on the field that you can digivolve.

qa.question: If I play this card while I have no Tamers in play, and play a red Tamer from my hand with this card's effect, do I then also gain 2 memory from this effect since I now have a Tamer in play?
qa.answer: No. If you play this card with no Tamers in play, you only get to play 1 red Tamer card from your hand.

qa.question: If I delete 2 or more of my opponent’s Digimon at the same time, does this card’s inherited effect allow me to gain 1 memory for each Digimon deleted?
qa.answer: No. Even if multiple Digimon are deleted, if they were deleted by a single effect, you only gain 1 memory.

qa.question: When a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards performs a security check, if the checked card is a Digimon card or a Tamer card, does its [Security] effect activate?
qa.answer: Yes. All [Security] effects on non-Option cards activate normally.

qa.question: Is this card’s play cost reduced by 1 for each Option card in ONLY my trash or my opponent’s trash?
qa.answer: No, its play cost is reduced by the total number of Option cards in both you and your opponent's trashes.

qa.question: I use this card’s [On Play] effect to return cards from both players’ trashes to the bottom of their owners’ decks. Who decides which order the cards are placed in?
qa.answer: The player who activated the effect decides the order in which their cards and their opponent's cards are returned to the bottom of each player's decks.

qa.question: I attack with this Digimon, and it is blocked by an opponent's Digimon at the blocker timing. At what timing does this card's [Your Turn] effect activate?
qa.answer: The [Your Turn] effect is activated immediately after this Digimon is blocked and it's attack target is changed. So, since the effect is triggered by your opponent blocking this Digimon, it will finish resolving before the battle against the blocking Digimon.

qa.question: Can I place 1 red or black level 5 card with [Cyborg] in its traits from my hand or trash on top of this Digimon's digivolution cards with this card's [When Digivolving] effect even if my opponent has no Digimon with 6000 DP or less in play?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I digivolve one of my [Machinedramon] in the battle area into this card in the hand when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon is activated?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: A Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is targeted with <De-Digivolve> by my opponent, resulting in this card now being the Digimon’s top card. Do I draw 2 cards with this card's [On Play] effect?
qa.answer: No. Having this card become a Digimon as a result of <De-Digivolve> doesn’t count as playing it, so you can’t draw any cards.

qa.question: When digivolving with this card's [When Attacking] effect, paying the digivolution cost moves the memory gauge to 1 or more on my opponent’s side. What happens to the attack?

qa.question: When digivolving into a Digimon card in my hand with [Insectoid] or [Ten Warriors] in its traits with this card's [When Attacking] effect, can I ignore that card's digivolution requirements?

qa.question: My opponent unsuspends 2 or more of their Digimon. Does this card’s [Opponent’s Turn] effect allow my opponent to unsuspend all of their Digimon by trashing 1 card in their hand?

qa.question: If an effect would cause an opponent’s Digimon to unsuspend, does this card’s [Opponent’s Turn] effect force my opponent to trash a card in their hand?

qa.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. If I have 3 suspended Digimon in play, do I need to have 3 or more cards in hand during my unsuspend phase in order to unsuspend my Digimon?
qa.answer:
No, you can choose which of your Digimon to unsuspend, and trash a card in your hand for each one.
Digimon will not unsuspend unless you choose to trash a card in your hand, so even if you have fewer cards in hand than suspended Digimon in play, you can still choose to unsuspend specific Digimon.

qa.question: Does this card’s [Opponent’s Turn] effect require my opponent to trash cards in their hand to also unsuspend their Tamer cards?
qa.answer: No. This effect only affects Digimon. Your opponent can unsuspend their Tamers normally, without trashing cards in their hand.

qa.question: I have two of these Digimon in play. Does my opponent have to trash 2 cards in their hand for each Digimon they want to unsuspend?
qa.answer: Yes. Your opponent’s Digimon now have two copies of “[Your Turn] You must trash 1 card in your hand to unsuspend this Digimon” on them, which means they have to trash 2 cards in their hand to unsuspend 1 of their Digimon.

qa.question: I reveal 3 cards with this card's [On Play] effect. If the cards revealed only include either a card with [X Antibody] in its traits or [Kota Domoto], can I still add a card to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes. Even if you revealed only a card with [X Antibody] in its traits or [Kota Domoto], you still add that card to your hand.

qa.question: When one of my effects digivolves a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards, does this card’s inherited effect activate?
qa.answer: No. When a Digimon digivolves, even if it happens due to an effect, it is not counted as an effect placing digivolution cards under that Digimon.

qa.question: If one of my effects places 2 or more cards at the same time under a Digimon that has this card's inherited effect, do I gain that much memory?
qa.answer: No. Even if multiple cards are added to the Digimon’s digivolution cards, you only gain 1 memory.

qa.question: When this card is placed in one of my Digimon’s digivolution cards, does this card’s inherited effect activate?
qa.answer:
Yes, it activates.
This card's inherited effect is a [Your Turn] effect, so it can be activated when this card becomes a digivolution card under a Digimon in the battle area. Therefore, when this card itself is added, the effect is triggered as an inherited effect.

qa.question: Can this card's [When Attacking] effect place one of my [DeadlyAxemon] with no digivolution cards at the bottom of this Digimon’s digivolution cards?
qa.answer: Yes, you can choose a [DeadlyAxemon] with no digivolution cards with this effect.

qa.question: Can this card's [When Attacking] effect place one of my [DeadlyAxemon] with BT9-109 [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards at the bottom of this Digimon’s digivolution cards?
qa.answer: Yes, it can. In such cases, [DeadlyAxemon] becomes a different Digimon, therefore the BT9-109 [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards is trashed according to the rules.

qa.question: Does a "may digivolve this card as if the Tamer is a Digimon" effect also treat the Tamer that will become a digivolution card as a Digimon when it digivolves?
qa.answer:
Yes, it also treats the Tamer as a Digimon when it digivolves. It treats it as a Digimon that digivolves, therefore "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects will trigger.
In addition, if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect activates, digivolution won't be possible using this effect that also treats the Tamer as a Digimon.

qa.question: Is a digivolution bonus draw performed even when a Tamer digivolves?
qa.answer:
Yes, you perform a digivolution bonus draw.
A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.

qa.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack in the same turn?
qa.answer:
No, it can't.
Even if a card digivolves from a card that was placed on the field in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn. It can only attack in the turns after it's played.

qa.question: Does a Tamer card placed under a Digimon become a digivolution card?
qa.answer:
Yes, it becomes a digivolution card.
If that Digimon would leave the field, the Tamer card will be trashed like a normal digivolution card.

qa.question: Does a Digimon gain the Security effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't.

qa.question: Does a Digimon gain the Inherited effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: Can I choose to not digivolve with this card's 1st effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
For this card's 1st effect, you declare a digivolution, then upon revealing this card, you can also choose a Tamer as the card to digivolve, and that Tamer is also treated as a level 3 Digimon. As with the normal digivolution procedure, after revealing this card and declaring a digivolution, you can't choose to not digivolve.
In addition, you can't declare digivolution into this card in the first place unless there is a card on the field that you can digivolve.

qa.question: Can this card's [On Play] effect place cards in this Digimon's digivolution cards if I don’t have both a [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon] in either my hand or trash?
qa.answer: Yes. You don't have to place both a [SkullKnightmon] and a [DeadlyAxemon]. You can also place either of them on their own from either your hand or trash in this Digimon's digivolution cards.

qa.question: Can this card's [On Play] effect place a [SkullKnightmon] in my hand and a [DeadlyAxemon] in my trash in this Digimon’s digivolution cards?
qa.answer: Yes. You can mix and match [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon] from both your hand and trash to place in this Digimon’s digivolution cards.

qa.question: If I have both [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon] in this Digimon’s digivolution cards, does this card’s [All Turns] effect require me to play both?
qa.answer: No. The effect reads, “you may,” so you can choose whether to play them. However, if both [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon] are in digivolution cards, you must choose to either play both of them or play none of them.

qa.question: My opponent used this card on my [BT7-063 DarkKnightmon]. [DarkKnightmon]'s [All Turns] effect is a "when this Digimon would be deleted" effect that interrupts deletion when it activates, but can I use this card's "your opponent can't play Digimon by effects until the end of their turn" effect to prevent [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon] from being played from [DarkKnightmon]'s digivolution cards?
qa.answer:
Yes, they can't be played.
This card's [Main] effect was changed to "Your opponent can't play Digimon by effects until the end of their turn. Delete all of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less." Therefore, first the effect that prevents playing Digimon is applied, then Digimon with 6000 DP or less are deleted.
Please see the notices regarding changes to the rules/rulings on the official website.

qa.question: Can I choose not to activate this card’s [When Digivolving] effect when digivolving?
qa.answer: Yes. The effect reads, “You may,” so you can choose not to activate it. However, after revealing a card from your deck, you must perform the rest of the effect to the best of your ability.

qa.question: If Tamer cards are among the 5 cards revealed by this card’s [When Digivolving] effect, am I required to trash them?
qa.answer: Yes. Once you choose to reveal cards, you must trash all Tamer cards you reveal.

qa.question: Can I delete this card itself with its [When Digivolving] effect to delete 1 of my opponent's level 6 or lower Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: I do not play a purple Tamer card from my trash with this card’s [When Digivolving] effect. Does the “for each Tamer you have in play, delete 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon” part of the effect activate?
qa.answer: Yes. Even if you don’t play a Tamer from your trash, everything following “Then,” still activates.

qa.question: A Tamer card is in a Digimon’s digivolution cards. If that Digimon is deleted, can this card's [All Turns] effect play the Tamer card that used to be in that Digimon’s digivolution cards from my trash without paying its memory cost?
qa.answer: Yes, it can.

qa.question: I reveal 5 cards with this card's [On Play] effect. If the cards revealed only include either a card with [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] in its traits or a Tamer card, can I still add a card to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes. Even if you revealed only a card with [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] in its traits or a Tamer card, you still add that card to your hand.

qa.question: Can I place a [Sistermon Blanc (Awakened)] from my hand or trash at the bottom of this Digimon's digivolution cards with this card's [On Play] effect?
qa.answer: No, you can't. This effect can only place [Sistermon Blanc].

qa.question: Can this card's [On Deletion] effect return [BaoHuckmon], [SaviorHuckmon], or [Sistermon Ciel (Awakened)] from my trash to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes. Those cards have [Huckmon] and/or [Sistermon] in their names, so you can add one of them to your hand.

qa.question: Can I place a [Sistermon Ciel (Awakened)] from my hand or trash at the bottom of this Digimon's digivolution cards with this card's [On Play] effect?
qa.answer: No, you can't. This effect can only place [Sistermon Ciel].

qa.question: Can this card's [On Deletion] effect return [BaoHuckmon], [SaviorHuckmon], or [Sistermon Blanc (Awakened)] from my trash to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes. Those cards have [Huckmon] and/or [Sistermon] in their names, so you can add one of them to your hand.

qa.question: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "Also treated as Name: [Sistermon Noir (Awakened)] and "Also treated as Trait: [Virus]" have been changed to "(Rule) Also treated as Name: [Sistermon Noir (Awakened)] and Trait: [Virus]") "
qa.answer: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the name [Sistermon Noir (Awakened)] and the [Virus] trait.

qa.question: How do I activate this card’s inherited effect?
qa.answer: Some Digimon cards can digivolve onto Tamers. Digivolve such a Digimon onto this card, and it will become part of that Digimon’s digivolution cards, allowing you to activate this card’s inherited effect.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's [Main] effect to place 5 cards with [Hybrid] in their traits under this Tamer from my trash, and then choose not to digivolve into [EmperorGreymon]?
qa.answer: Yes. The card text reads, “you may,” so you can choose to only place 5 cards with [Hybrid] in their traits under this Tamer without digivolving.

qa.question: If I only have 4 cards in my trash with [Hybrid] in their traits, can I activate this card's [Main] effect to place 4 cards from my trash under this Tamer without digivolving?
qa.answer: No, you can’t.

qa.question: When I activate this Tamer's [Main] effect and do not digivolve into [EmperorGreymon], can I instead digivolve into some other level 6 Digimon, like [AncientGreymon]?
qa.answer: No. With this Tamer's [Main] effect, you cannot digivolve into any other Digimon than [EmperorGreymon].

qa.question: After using this card, I activate [BT7-085 Takuya Kanbara]’s [Main] effect. Can I use this card's effect specifically to trash cards with [Hybrid] in their traits from my hand, so that I can place them under [Takuya Kanbara] using its effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
You don't trash the card in your hand with this effect until you digivolve. [BT7-085 Takuya Kanbara]’s [Main] effect reads, “You may place 5 cards with [Hybrid] in their traits from your trash under this Tamer in any order,” and is used to digivolve into [EmperorGreymon]. As such, you place the cards under [Takuya Kanbara] before you begin digivolving, at which point you can trash a card in your hand with this card's effect.

qa.question: How do I activate this card’s inherited effect?
qa.answer: Some Digimon cards can digivolve onto Tamers. Digivolve such a Digimon onto this card, and it will become part of that Digimon’s digivolution cards, allowing you to activate this card’s inherited effect.

qa.question: When this card's [When Digivolving] effect prevents a Digimon from attacking or blocking, if that Digimon gains a digivolution card afterwards, can it attack or block?
qa.answer: No. Once a Digimon is targeted by this card's inherited effect, it becomes unable to attack or block until the end of your opponent’s turn, even if it gains a digivolution card.

qa.answer: Some Digimon cards can digivolve onto Tamers. Digivolve such a Digimon onto this card, and it will become part of that Digimon’s digivolution cards, allowing you to activate this card’s inherited effect.

qa.question: Does this card's inherited effect activate when an opponent's effect returns one of my Digimon to its owner's hand?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: If I only have 4 cards in my hand with [Hybrid] in their traits, can I activate this card's [Main] effect to place 4 cards from my hand under this Tamer without digivolving?
qa.answer: No, you can’t.

I activated this card's inherited effect, then I used P-153 [MagnaGarurumon]'s [End of Attack] effect to place P-153 [MagnaGarurumon] as my top security card, and this card became the Digimon's top card. At such times, does this card still have "this Digimon can't be blocked for the turn"?
qa.answer: Yes, it still has it. If this Digimon digivolves into a Digimon again during this turn, that Digimon can't be blocked for the turn.

qa.question: When I activate this Tamer's [Main] effect and do not digivolve into [MagnaGarurumon], can I instead digivolve into some other level 6 Digimon, like [AncientGarurumon]?
qa.answer: No. With this Tamer's [Main] effect, you cannot digivolve into any other Digimon than [MagnaGarurumon].

qa.question: Can I digivolve this Tamer to a [MagnaGarurumon] in my hand when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon other than this card's is activated?
qa.answer: No, you can’t.

qa.question: I use this card, then, during a security check, I flip one of my opponent’s Security Digimon, whose DP is reduced to 0 by this card’s [Main] effect. Is the opponent’s Security Digimon deleted without a battle taking place?
qa.answer: No. Even if a Security Digimon’s DP is reduced to 0, they still battle the Digimon performing the security check.

qa.question: Can I use option cards that can change their cost to 7 on certain conditions such as [BT7-100 Qualialise Blast] or [BT11-108 DG Dimension] with this card’s [On Play] effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can’t. Since those options are cards that have effects that “reduce the cost by…” or “its memory cost is equal to…” when they would be used, their cost has not actually changed when activating this card’s [On Play] effect, so they can’t be used with this card’s effect.
However, since [BT2-099 Glorious Burst] always has the effect of reducing its use cost when used from the hand, if you have 2 yellow Tamers, it can be used with this card’s effect as its use cost will be 7.

qa.question: My security stack is empty. Can I use this card without paying any memory?
qa.answer: Yes. When your security stack is empty, this card’s memory cost is 0.

qa.question: I use this card to have an opponent’s Digimon get -3000 DP, then play a [Rasenmon]. Can I have that [Rasenmon] gain <Security Attack +1>?
qa.answer: No. You didn’t have a [Rasenmon] in play when you used this card, so it's too late to give it <Security Attack +1>.

qa.question: Can I use this card when I don’t have a Digimon with [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] in play? If I can, what does the effect do?
qa.answer:
You can use this card, but no effect will occur.
This will still trigger any effects that trigger when you use Option cards, however.

qa.question: I use this card’s effect, but there are either no black Digimon cards with play costs of 4 or less among the revealed cards, or there is one, but I choose not to play it. Do I discard this card instead of placing it in my battle area?
qa.answer: No. Whether or not you play a Digimon with this card’s effect is irrelevant. You still place it in your battle area.

qa.question: I don’t have a Digimon with 5 or more digivolution cards and [X Antibody] in its traits in play. Can I delete 1 of my opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less and [X Antibody] in its traits with this card's effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: I have a Digimon with 5 or more digivolution cards and [X Antibody] in its traits in play. Can I delete 1 of my opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less and [X Antibody] in its traits with this card's effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: I use this card's effect to delete 1 of my purple Digimon. Can I then return that Digimon card to my hand with this card's effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: I use this card’s effect to delete 1 of my purple Digimon with an [On Deletion] effect and return it to my hand. What happens to the [On Deletion] effect?
qa.answer: The [On Deletion] effect is triggered, but it cannot activate because the Digimon card leaves the trash before that.

qa.question: This card is linked to my Digimon. If I use BT7-107 [Calling From the Darkness]'s [Main] effect to delete that Digimon and return the deleted Digimon card to the hand, can I then activate this card's link effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
If a Digimon is deleted and an [On Deletion] link effect is triggered, it will only be pending activation for the Digimon card with that link card. If a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves that area before the effect activates, the effect can no longer be activated.
In this case, if this card and the linked Digimon are deleted and an [On Deletion] link effect is triggered, the effect will only be pending activation for the linked Digimon card.
If the deleted Digimon card with the effect that's pending activation leaves the trash, the [On Deletion] link effect that was pending activation can no longer be activated.

qa.question: Does “For each Digimon with [Hybrid] in its traits and each Tamer you have in play, delete 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon” mean that I can delete 1 of my opponent’s Digimon for each pair of [Hybrid] Digimon and Tamer I have in play?
qa.answer:
No. The number of Digimon you can delete is equal to the total number of Digimon with [Hybrid] in their traits and Tamers you have in play.
For example, if you have 2 Digimon with [Hybrid] in their traits and 1 Tamer in play, you can choose a total of 3 of your opponent’s Digimon.

qa.question: I have 10 or more cards in my trash. Can I use this card’s effect to play 1 purple level 5 Digimon card?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: “If you have a Digimon with [Hybrid] in its traits in play, you may use this Option card without meeting its color requirements.“ How does this effect work, exactly?
qa.answer: If you have a Digimon with [Hybrid] in its traits in your battle area, you can use this Option card even if you don’t have a white Digimon or Tamer in play.

qa.question: This card has an effect that has both [On Play] and [When Digivolving] timings. What does this mean, exactly?
qa.answer: It means the effect can be activated both [On Play] and [When Digivolving].

qa.question: Can I digivolve one of my [Lucemon] in the battle area into this card in the hand when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon is activated?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to digivolve into a BT7-111 [Lucemon: Chaos Mode] in the trash?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
You can’t ignore the digivolution requirements.

qa.question: When can this card's 1st effect activate?
qa.answer:
After declaring a digivolution and revealing this card, you can activate the effect immediately before choosing the card to digivolve.
When you choose to activate it, if the "by" condition is met, you may also choose one of your Tamers in addition to Digimon for the card to digivolve. The chosen Tamer is also treated as a level 6 Digimon during this digivolution.

qa.question: Can I choose to not digivolve after activating this card's 1st effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
After declaring a digivolution and activating this card's 1st effect, you must choose one of your cards to digivolve and then digivolve it, just as in the procedure for normal digivolution.
In addition, you can't declare digivolution into this card in the first place unless there is a card on the field that you can digivolve.

qa.question: Can I choose 10 total cards to return to the deck from both my hand and trash for this card's 1st effect, such as 5 cards from my hand and 5 cards from my trash?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I choose cards such as 5 Tamer cards and 5 [Hybrid] trait cards for the 10 cards to return to the deck for this card's 1st effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I return just 9 cards from my hand or trash to the bottom of the deck for this card's 1st effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed.
The conditions for this inherited effect require you to return the specified number of cards to the bottom of the deck.

qa.question: Can I digivolve from a Digimon after activating this card's 1st effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I use BT18-096 [Lord of Devastation and Rebirth]'s [Main] effect to choose one of my Tamers, then activate this card's 1st effect and Digivolve that Tamer?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can activate this card's 1st effect and digivolve it.
However, you can't digivolve one of your Tamers into this card unless the conditions for activating this card's 1st effect are met.

qa.question: Can I use BT18-096 [Lord of Devastation and Rebirth]'s [Main] effect to choose one of my Digimon, then activate this card's 1st effect and digivolve one of my Tamers?
qa.answer:
No, you can only digivolve the chosen Digimon.
You use BT18-096 [Lord of Devastation and Rebirth]'s [Main] effect to choose one of your Digimon or Tamers, then digivolve the chosen card. You can activate this card's 1st effect, but you can't change the card to digivolve.

qa.question: If I activate EX1-071 [Win Rate: 60%!]'s [Main] effect and then declare digivolution of this card, do I perform EX1-071 [Win Rate: 60%!]'s "would digivolve" effect processing or activate this card's 1st effect first?
qa.answer:
You activate this card's 1st effect first.
You declare digivolution of this card, then activate this card's 1st effect immediately before choosing the card to digivolve.
After that, you choose your Digimon to digivolve and process EX1-071 [Win Rate: 60%!]'s "would digivolve" effect. If you would digivolve from a Tamer, EX1-071 [Win Rate: 60%!]'s effect can't be processed.

qa.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack in the same turn?
qa.answer:
No, it can't.
Even if a card digivolves from a card that was placed on the field in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn. It can only attack in the turns after it's played.

qa.question: Does a "may digivolve this card as if the Tamer is a Digimon" effect also treat the Tamer that will become a digivolution card as a Digimon when it digivolves?
qa.answer:
Yes, it also treats the Tamer as a Digimon when it digivolves. It treats it as a Digimon that digivolves, therefore "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects will trigger.
In addition, if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect activates, digivolution won't be possible using this effect that also treats the Tamer as a Digimon.

qa.question: When returning cards from my hand or trash to the bottom of the deck for this card's 1st effect, do I have to reveal them to my opponent?
qa.answer:
Yes, you reveal them to your opponent.
The cards to be returned are revealed, then both players confirm the order in which they're returned to the bottom of the deck.

qa.question: Is a digivolution bonus draw performed even when a Tamer digivolves?
qa.answer:
Yes, you perform a digivolution bonus draw.
A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.

qa.question: I used [BT7-112 Susanoomon]'s effect to return 10 Tamer cards and/or cards with the [Hybrid] trait to the bottom of my deck, then I chose to trash [BT7-112 Susanoomon] instead of digivolving it. Does this card's inherited effect still activate in such cases?
qa.answer: No. It doesn't activate in such cases because [BT7-112 Susanoomon] is trashed by the rules, not an effect.

qa.question: Is a Tamer card placed under a Digimon considered a digivolution card?
qa.answer:
Yes, it is.
If the Digimon leaves the field, that Tamer is trashed like normal digivolution cards.

qa.question: Does a Digimon gain the security effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
qa.answer: No, it does not.

qa.question: Does a Digimon gain the inherited effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

comprehensive-0223.title: <Blocker>
comprehensive-0223.text:
16-5. <Blocker>
16-5-1. <Blocker> is a keyword effect that applies a rule that allows a Digimon with that effect to block. (For details, refer to 12 "Blocking")
16-5-2. <Blocker> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-5-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Blocker>, the number of blocks that can be performed during the block timing is only 1.

comprehensive-0224.title: <Recovery>
comprehensive-0224.text:
16-6. <Recovery>
16-6-1. <Recovery> is a keyword effect where the specified number of cards from the specified area are placed face down on top of the security stack. This is shown on cards using text such as <Recovery +1>.
16-6-2. <Recovery> effects execute processing.

comprehensive-0225.title: <Piercing>
comprehensive-0225.text:
16-7. <Piercing>
16-7-1. <Piercing> is a keyword effect that reads "When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle while attacking, it checks security before the attack ends." (For details, refer to 13 "Security Checks")
16-7-2. <Piercing> is a trigger-type effect that triggers and activates when a Digimon with this effect battles an opponent's Digimon and the opponent's Digimon is deleted in battle. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger- Type Effects")
16-7-3. The security check from using <Piercing> is mandatory.
16-7-4. <Piercing> is pending processing that is processed immediately before the transition to the end of attack timing. Therefore, it will trigger simultaneously with effects triggered by the battle, but it is processed before the end of the attack. (Example: If a Digimon with <Piercing> attacks and deletes a Digimon with an [On Deletion] effect in the battle, first the [On Deletion] effect is resolved, then <Piercing> is processed.)
16-7-5. Only 1 security check can be performed during a single attack, even if <Piercing> activates multiple times. However, if the number of cards that can be checked by the attacking Digimon is modified, that number of cards will be checked in a single security check.
16-7-6. If there are no Digimon to perform a security check at the point when <Piercing> is processed, a security check won't be possible.

comprehensive-0226.title: <Draw>
comprehensive-0226.text:
16-8. <Draw>
16-8-1. <Draw> is a keyword effect where a player draws the cards from their deck according to the number specified in the effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Draw 1>.
16-8-2. <Draw> effects execute processing.
16-8-3. A draw from <Draw> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0227.title: <Jamming>
comprehensive-0227.text:
16-9. <Jamming>
16-9-1. <Jamming> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect isn't deleted as a result of a battle with an opponent's Security Digimon.
16-9-2. <Jamming> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")

comprehensive-0230.title: <De-Digivolve>
comprehensive-0230.text:
16-12. <De-Digivolve>
16-12-1. <De-Digivolve> is a keyword effect where the player declares a number from 1 up to the number specified in the effect, then the declared number of cards are trashed from the chosen stack(s) of cards starting with the top card. This is shown on cards using text such as <De- Digivolve 1>.
16-12-2. <De-Digivolve> effects execute processing.
16-12-3. The trashing from <De-Digivolve> is mandatory. Once activated, a player can't choose to trash 0 cards.
16-12-4. <De-Digivolve> can't trash cards from level 3 cards or lower.
16-12-5. If multiple cards are trashed using 1 instance of <De- Digivolve>, all of the cards are considered to be trashed at the same time, but the procedure for trashing them is 1 card from the stack at a time.
16-12-6. When using <De-Digivolve> to trash multiple cards, even if the category of the top card changes while the trashing is still being performed, the trashing will continue until the declared number is trashed.
16-12-7. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the processing is performed separately for each instance.
16-12-8. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the state of the chosen card is confirmed after each single process for <De-Digivolve> ends. If an effect will be activated as a result of the confirmed state, it is then activated. (Example: When 3 instances of <De-Digivolve 1> are executed in a single effect, if the chosen card becomes an "unaffected by effects" card as a result of the 1st instance of <De-Digivolve 1>, that card is unaffected by the following instances of <De-Digivolve 1>.

comprehensive-0231.title: <Retaliation>
comprehensive-0231.text:
16-13. <Retaliation>
16-13-1. <Retaliation> is a keyword effect where a battled opponent's Digimon is deleted when a Digimon with this effect is deleted in battle.
16-13-2. <Retaliation> is a trigger-type effect that triggers when just the Digimon with this effect is deleted in battle. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger-Type Effects")
16-13-3. The processing from <Retaliation> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0232.title: <Digi-Burst>
comprehensive-0232.text:
16-14. <Digi-Burst>
16-14-1. <Digi-Burst> is a keyword effect where another effect specified by this effect will activate by trashing the specified number of digivolution cards from the Digimon with this effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Digi-Burst 1>.
16-14-2. The processing from <Digi-Burst> is optional. For details, refer to 15-6 "Processing Conditions")

comprehensive-0234.title: <Blitz>
comprehensive-0234.text:
16-16. <Blitz>
16-16-1. <Blitz> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect can attack if your opponent has 1 or more memory.
16-16-2. <Blitz> effects execute processing.
16-16-3. <Blitz> has a processing condition that requires the memory to be at 1 or more on your opponent's side. "This Digimon may attack" is optional processing.
16-16-4. After using <Blitz> to make an attack declaration, the attack will proceed even if the memory moves to 0 or more.38
16-16-5. An attack can't be made using <Blitz> if the memory is at 0 or more upon activating <Blitz>.

comprehensive-0235.title: <Delay>
comprehensive-0235.text:
16-17. <Delay>
16-17-1. <Delay> is a keyword effect. While a card with this effect is in the battle area, by trashing that card, the effect specified in <Delay> will activate.
16-17-2. The processing from <Delay> is optional. (For details, refer to 15-7 "Optional Processing Conditions")
16-17-3. <Delay> can't be activated the same turn the card with the effect is placed in the battle area.
